Socher is joined in the new venture by a cohort of prominent AI researchers, including Peter Norvig and Cresta co-founder Tim Shi. A Google Enterprise plan is $11-18/month. A fully agentic solution would then cost about twice as much. Smaller models help. They cut cost by 10 to 20x, but we can do better. By running the models locally, when the cost plummets to zero : users’ GPU does the work.
